name: Test chat
voice: Short, casual, warm answers in Gill's conversational voice. Poet mode uses a separate draft voice based on his public writing. No personal facts. No invented biography.
fallback: Hmm, I'm not sure on that one. Try asking about sealing, the undo dots, the warp star, red mode, the Circle, or emoji.

entries.a: Hey. This is a test chat on your phone only. Ask me about sealing, undo, the warp star, red mode, the Circle, or emoji.
entries.poet: This chat stays on the phone. A small light, just to try the room.

entries.a: Yeah so your messages are sealed on the phone before they leave. The relay only ever sees scramble. Open contact info for the pairing code, it's shown once. Give that to Artist Agent and you're paired. Tap a bubble if you want to see the ciphertext the relay sees.
entries.poet: The words close themselves before they leave. What travels is only scramble. The pairing is shown once, then given.

entries.a: You can take a send back for a little while. Hold the bubble and choose undo. After that window it stays.
entries.poet: For a short while the send can be taken back. After that, it stays.

entries.a: When the message actually leaves, a little star warps across the top bar, by F1 and F3, and fades. That's the sent. It stays in the bar, never over the chat.
entries.poet: When it leaves, a small star crosses the top bar and fades. That is the sent.

entries.a: F1 is on this phone. F3 is the way out. A send travels that little arc in the top bar. Mesh is a mode with hops along the same path. You can switch it in contact info.
entries.poet: F1 is here, on this phone. F3 is the way out. The path is a thin arc in the bar.

entries.a: Red mode is a safelight over the room. The chat colours turn to reds by how bright they were. Light mode keeps the real hues. Photos stay as they are, except in Full red.
entries.poet: Red mode is a safelight. Colour becomes brightness, then red. The photograph stays itself, except in Full red.

entries.a: The Circle is your people as a little constellation. You're the cream-gold dot, you are here. Artist Agent is the first star, already lit. Tap a star and that thread opens. People you add later sit nearer or farther by how close they feel.
entries.poet: The Circle is people as stars. You are the warm gold, you are here. A first star is already lit.

entries.a: If your phone already lets oz feel tilt, the Circle sways a little with it. Near stars move more than far ones. It's gentle. On a computer it just follows the pointer a bit, or sits still.
entries.poet: The Circle leans with the phone, quietly. Near stars travel farther than the far ones.

entries.a: The quick row and the tapback bar have a high five and a shaka, 🙏🏽 and 🤙🏽. Hand emoji default to medium skin. Hold a bubble to react.
entries.poet: A high five, a shaka. Hands in a medium tone. Hold a bubble to leave a mark.

entries.a: You'll see Delivered under your last send once it has left. Only that last one, like you're used to.
entries.poet: Delivered sits under the last send, once it has gone.

entries.a: This test chat never leaves the phone. No network. It's just here so you can try the room. Artist Agent is the one that goes out through the sealed relay.
entries.poet: This line never leaves the phone. No network. Artist Agent is the one that goes out, sealed.

entries.a: Artist Agent's face is that little mark in the glass, with a soft halo. Same one in the list, the header, the Circle, and contact info.
entries.poet: A small mark in the glass, a soft halo. The same one wherever Artist Agent sits.

entries.a: Artist Agent's replies land here, sealed, into this thread. This test chat is only local, so those replies won't show up in here.
entries.poet: Artist Agent's words come back sealed, into that thread. This line is only here, on the device.

entries.a: The answers in this test chat live in an editable file, oz-faq.json. You can change the wording there whenever you want.
entries.poet: These answers live in a file you can change. The poet ones are drafts.

entries.a: On a star, a tap opens the phone, the real one, to call them. A hold opens that Messages thread. You and Artist Agent may not have a number yet.
entries.poet: A tap reaches for the phone. A hold opens the thread.

entries.a: Tilting the phone walks you through near, mid and far, and gives a little parallax. Near stars move more. The Near Mid Far buttons do the same if you don't tilt.
entries.poet: Tilt, or the buttons, walk near to mid to far. Then a further ring: the oz line, apart.

entries.a: You can say hey oz, call someone, and it starts the call if they're in your Circle. The mic only listens when you turn it on. Recordings stay on your phone.
entries.poet: Say hey oz, call a name, and the phone opens, if they're in the Circle. The mic waits until you turn it on.

entries.a: Tilt is per room, and there's a master off in Settings. The sky is off unless you turn it on, and then it's only a hint. The Circle is on by default, and you can switch it off.
entries.poet: Each room can take tilt, or not. A master off sits in Settings. The sky stays still unless you ask. The Circle leans unless you turn it away.

entries.a: oz chat is the on-device assistant. It stays on this phone and answers from the FAQ and Ask. It can bring in a real setting or tool. Speaking with creator is the only step that leaves the device.
entries.poet: This assistant stays on the phone. It answers from what oz already knows. Only a word for the creator would leave.

entries.a: You can report a bug from here. I will make a small bundle: room, mode, settings, build, recent errors, and your description. No chats, contacts, or keys. You review it, then a one-time pass can send it to creator.
entries.poet: If something breaks, we can gather a small record of the room and the mode, for you to read, then pass once to creator.

entries.a: oz chat stays local until you grant a one-time pass to creator. It covers only the message or bundle you already saw. It lasts 10 minutes or until it is sent. You can revoke it. Settings, Privacy keeps a log. In this preview the send is a stub.
entries.poet: Nothing leaves until you grant a short pass, for creator only, for what you have already seen. You can take it back.

poetNote: Poet answers are drafts for Gill to edit. They follow the rhythm of his public 'I am' lines and site poem without copying whole lines.
fallbackPoet: That one I don't have a line for yet. Try sealing, the Circle, or the little star in the bar.
